name: Expéditeur · Envoi emails (gated)
description: Envoie les pré-audits (vue envoi_preaudits : validés, et brouillons écrits par le code, seuls depuis le 14/10/2026), au plafond du jour, un e-mail toutes les 0,7 s ; relit la livraison chez Resend. Source : n8n/expediteur_envoi.json du dépôt raime-cerveau.

parameters.query: SELECT mode, from_email, from_name, test_to, plafond_envoi('preaudits') AS plafond FROM send_config WHERE id = 1

SELECT id, to_email, subject, body, prospect_name, status FROM envoi_preaudits ORDER BY (status = 'valide') DESC, (departement = '74') DESC, (departement IN ('01', '73', '38', '69')) DESC, score DESC NULLS LAST, id LIMIT greatest(0, coalesce(plafond_envoi('preaudits'), 0) - (SELECT count(*)::int FROM outreach WHERE status = 'envoye' AND sent_at >= date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris'))

SELECT 'outreach' AS t, id, resend_id FROM outreach WHERE resend_id IS NOT NULL AND status = 'envoye' AND sent_at > now() - interval '5 days' AND sent_at < now() - interval '1 hour' AND coalesce(livraison, '') NOT IN ('delivered', 'bounced', 'complained', 'opened', 'clicked') UNION ALL SELECT 'vitrines_envoi', id, resend_id FROM vitrines_envoi WHERE resend_id IS NOT NULL AND statut = 'envoye' AND envoye_le > now() - interval '5 days' AND envoye_le < now() - interval '1 hour' AND coalesce(livraison, '') NOT IN ('delivered', 'bounced', 'complained', 'opened', 'clicked') ORDER BY 2 LIMIT 80
